1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Check if alt/cmd+v shortcut exists for clipboard image paste in Ghostty terminal, and diagnose why it works intermittently

   - Design and implement a feature discoverability system (ghostty-help, ghostty-tip, contextual hints)
   - Run `/end` to close the session

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - macOS NSPasteboard clipboard types (PNG, TIFF, text) and why image-only clipboard silently fails with `paste_from_clipboard`
   - ghostty keybind actions: `paste_from_clipboard` (text-only), no `run_command` action exists
   - macOS Automator Service + `NSUserKeyEquivalents` App Shortcuts as workaround for ghostty keybind limitations
   - OSC 2 terminal title sequences (cross-platform compatible)
   - OSC 11 background color change (SSH session detection)
   - macOS TTY paths `/dev/ttys*` for broadcast input via direct write
   - zsh `preexec`/`precmd` hooks via `add-zsh-hook`
   - `EPOCHREALTIME` for millisecond timing in zsh
   - fzf `--preview` for interactive terminal palette
   - Feature Adoption Funnel: Exposed(100%) → Activated(40%) → Used(20%) → Used Again(5%)
   - 3-layer discoverability: startup MOTD, contextual hints, user-initiated fzf palette
   - ghostty shell-integration features: cursor, sudo, ssh-env, title, path
   - ghostty 1.3.1 features: Quick Terminal, write_screen_file, notify-on-command-finish, conditional config, command palette

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`~/.config/ghostty/config`**
     - Removed `keybind = super+v=paste_from_clipboard` (was text-only, blocking image paste)
     - Added `clipboard-paste-bracketed-safe = false`
     - Final content:
       ```
       clipboard-read = allow
       clipboard-write = allow
       clipboard-paste-protection = false
       clipboard-paste-bracketed-safe = false
       image-storage-limit = 320000000
       ```

   - **`~/bin/img-paste`**
     - Created to handle Cmd+V for both image and text clipboard
     - Checks clipboard types via `osascript -e 'clipboard info'`
     - If image-only: saves to `/tmp/clipboard_img_out.png`, types path via `System Events keystroke`
     - If text: uses `paste_text()` via `osascript do shell script "pbpaste"` + keystroke
     - Modes: `--auto`, `--check`, `--save`
     - Registered as macOS Automator Service "Paste Image Path" at `~/Library/Services/`
     - Ghostty App Shortcut `@v` (Cmd+V) registered via `defaults write com.mitchellh.ghostty NSUserKeyEquivalents`

   - **`~/.config/ghostty/zsh-integration.zsh`**
     - Section 1: Line Timestamps — `_ghostty_preexec` records `$EPOCHREALTIME`, `_ghostty_precmd` outputs `─── HH:MM:SS ✓/✗ Xms` line
     - Section 2: Triggers — `_ghostty_run_triggers()` reads `~/.config/ghostty/triggers`, matches `cmd:<glob>` and `exit:<code>` patterns, fires `notify`/`bell`/`run` actions
     - Section 3: Profile Auto-Switch — SSH detection → OSC 11 background `#1a0d0d`
     - Section 4: Terminal Title State — `_ghostty_update_title()` via OSC 2: `[📡] zsh @ dir` (broadcast), `[ssh] zsh @ dir` (SSH), `zsh @ dir` (normal)
     - Section 5: Contextual Hints — `_ghostty_maybe_hint()` reads `features-registry.conf`, matches `hint_trigger` patterns, shows hint once/day via stamp files in `/tmp/ghostty-hints-$(id -u)/`
     - Broadcast hook in `_ghostty_preexec`: checks `/tmp/ghostty-broadcast-$(id -u).active` flag, writes to other TTYs if sender

   - **`~/.config/ghostty/triggers`**
     - Config file for pattern → action triggers
     - Format: `TYPE:PATTERN  ACTION [ARG]`
     - Default entries: npm/yarn/bun/make/cargo/go build → notify; exit:!0 → bell

   - **`~/.config/ghostty/features-registry.conf`**
     - Pipe-separated: `NAME|CATEGORY|WHEN|HOW|EXAMPLE|HINT_TRIGGER`
     - 10 features registered: Image Paste, Broadcast Input, SSH New Window, Line Timestamps, Triggers, Quick Terminal, notify-on-command-finish, write_screen_file, ghostty-broadcast --list, Profile Auto-Switch

   - **`~/bin/ghostty-broadcast`**
     - Sends text to all user-owned TTYs via `printf '%s\r' "$text" > "$tty_path"`
     - Scans `/dev/ttys*` checking `stat -f '%Su'` ownership
     - Modes: `--list`, `--toggle` (creates `/tmp/ghostty-broadcast-$(id -u).active`), `-n` (no enter), direct text
     - Toggle mode: writes sender TTY to `/tmp/ghostty-broadcast-$(id -u).sender`

   - **`~/bin/ssht`**
     - Opens SSH in new Ghostty window via `open -na /Applications/Ghostty.app --args -e "ssh ..."`
     - `--tab` mode uses AppleScript `keystroke "t" using command down` then types SSH command
     - `--list` shows `~/.ssh/config` hosts

   - **`~/bin/ghostty-help`**
     - fzf-based interactive palette: `fzf --preview --height=70% --border=rounded`
     - Preview function `preview_feature()` parses registry by name, shows category/when/how/example
     - On selection: extracts `how` field, copies to clipboard via `pbcopy`, prints to stdout

   - **`~/bin/ghostty-tip`**
     - Daily MOTD: reads registry, selects entry by `$(date +%j) % count` (date-based rotation)
     - `--once-a-day`: checks `/tmp/ghostty-tip-$(id -u)-$(date +%Y%m%d)` stamp file
     - Outputs colored tip with category, name, when, how, example
     - `--reset`: removes stamp file

       [[ -n "$GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR" ]] && source ~/.config/ghostty/zsh-integration.zsh
       [[ -n "$GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR" ]] && ghostty-tip --once-a-day

Solution: replaced ghostty's keybind with macOS Service calling `img-paste` script that checks clipboard type via `osascript -e 'clipboard info'`.
